label: Applying directly to a Japanese university for the September or October 2027 intake

rounds.label: UTokyo College of Design, Route B, September 2027 entry
rounds.note: Route B is the international-qualifications route and lists the IB, with an expected level of 38/42 plus 2 core points that the university says is not a cut-off. 50 of the 100 places. First screening result 22 December 2026, final decision 20 February 2027. Closes 17:00 JST.

rounds.label: Keio PEARL, Period I, September 2027 entry
rounds.note: Closes 15:00 JST. The three periods share one quota of about 100 places, so an early period competes for a fuller pool.

rounds.label: Keio PEARL, Period II, September 2027 entry
Keio PEARL, Period III, September 2027 entry
rounds.note: The latest closing date of any Japanese route recorded here, and the one that fits a Danish school year: predicted grades are settled by then and the result arrives on 24 May, after the examination session. Keio accepts predicted IB grades in as many words.

rounds.label: Waseda English-based undergraduate programmes, September 2027 entry
rounds.note: Not announced. As of 23 September 2026 Waseda's page carries only the window for September 2026 entry, 8 January to 10 February 2026. One application covers all six English-based schools. Check Waseda's page for the 2027 dates.

rounds.label: Kyoto University iUP, October 2027 enrolment
rounds.note: Closes 17:00 JST. Kyoto's Apply page gives the period as 2 November to 3 December 2026. Screening stages and result dates are in Kyoto's guidelines PDF.

rounds.label: Kyushu University international undergraduate programmes, October 2027 entry
rounds.note: A five-day window: the online system is open only from 7 to 11 December, so do not plan to start the form on the 11th. Documents also go by post. For the English-taught engineering programmes and Bioresource and Bioenvironment. No closing time is stated.

rounds.label: Tohoku University Gateway College, October 2027 entry
rounds.note: First-stage result 5 February, second stage 21–22 February 2027, successful applicants announced 24 March. Predicted IB scores are accepted. About 90 places for October entry.

milestones.label: UTokyo College of Design first screening result, Route B
UTokyo College of Design video assignment window
milestones.note: A separate submission after the application closes, inside a four-day window. Both routes require it, alongside essays, supporting materials and an English proficiency test result.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: Every Japanese decision in this route is made before this date — the earliest by four and a half months. What each university does with a place held against a predicted grade once the diploma arrives is set institution by institution and is not established here.

milestones.label: UTokyo College of Design: final IB results due
milestones.note: An offer made on predicted grades is conditional, and final scores must reach the university by 16 August 2027.

milestones.label: Certificate of Eligibility, then the Student visa
milestones.note: Not a published deadline. The university applies for the Certificate of Eligibility on your behalf once you accept; you take it to the Embassy of Japan in Copenhagen for the visa. Allow three months, and expect documents to need an apostille and sometimes notarisation.

submissionItems.label: Predicted IB grades and school transcript
submissionItems.note: Keio states outright that an IB Diploma or predicted grades is acceptable. Every round in this route closes before results exist, so predictions carry the application everywhere.

submissionItems.label: English proficiency test result
submissionItems.note: The UTokyo College of Design and Tohoku's Gateway College want TOEFL iBT 80, IELTS 6.0, Duolingo 110 or Cambridge 169 or more; Keio requires TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic. Whether an IB English A or B result substitutes is not confirmed for any of them, so ask.

submissionItems.label: Essays, a video assignment and supporting materials
submissionItems.note: The College of Design's selection is built on these rather than on a test score, and the video window falls after the application closes — a second deadline that is easy to miss.

submissionItems.label: Application fee, charged separately by each university
submissionItems.note: Each application is a separate payment. Keio PEARL charges JPY 35,000 for September 2027 entry; check the others on each university's page.

supplementarySteps: There is no central portal and no shared calendar. Build a list with one row per programme, holding its intake month — April, September or October — and its own closing date, and start it in the autumn of the year before entry.

Understand what you are comparing. The UTokyo College of Design is a five-year integrated bachelor's and master's programme; Keio PEARL and Waseda's schools are four-year bachelor's degrees; Kyoto iUP is four and a half years including a preparatory half-year in Japanese.

April 2027 entry is not realistic for a May 2027 IB candidate: its applications close in the middle of 2026. September or October 2027 is the intake, and if none of it works, the next September is a year away rather than six months.
Ask about apostille and notarisation early. Japanese universities generally want certified documents, and a Danish apostille takes time that a November deadline does not leave.

notes: Six institutions were read for their own dates — the University of Tokyo, Keio, Waseda, Kyoto, Kyushu and Tohoku. The others on the Japanese profile are listed and their rounds unread.
Re-check in November 2026, when Waseda is expected to publish its September 2027 window.
Not established: most application fees, and what each university does with a conditional place when results arrive on 6 July (the UTokyo College of Design wants final results by 16 August 2027).
